description: With the Sign.com ChatGPT app, users can draft agreements, contracts, and other documents, convert them into signing-ready PDFs, and open them directly in Sign.com to sign or send for signature. Users can generate documents from simple prompts or their own HTML, then continue the signing process on Sign.com to collect signatures, manage signers, and finalize documents.

defaultPrompt: Create an employment offer letter for Jane Doe and prepare it for signing.
